item.title: Version 1.5.0-beta (87)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.5.0-beta

Build 87

  • Gallery can accept or reject the large photo, compare it with another frame from the same scene, and open it in the editor, collage, or panorama.
  • Collage can drag a photo between cells, fill a layout from accepted photos, and set the border and the corner radius.
  • Panorama can step to the next photo in the folder, and turn or flip a JPEG without recompressing it.
  • Colour balance, split tone, a black-and-white mixer, colorize, a channel mixer, and a white-balance click.
  • Hold to see the photo before the grade, mark clipped tones, grow or shrink a subject mask, and drop a shadow on a caption.
